LESSON: ELEMENTS OF AND RESPONDING

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: LISTENING
Topic 3.1: Elements of AND RESPONDING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Elements of AND RESPONDING. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How does it make you a) express initial personal as sad, happy feel?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. imitate short melodies with asked to imitate them paying accuracy in pitch and rhythm attention to pitch and rhythm for aural development
2. use appropriate terminology in explaining/discussing •

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: ELEMENTS OF AND RESPONDING
This lesson teaches Elements of AND RESPONDING for Grade 3 MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. imitate short melodies with asked to imitate them paying accuracy in pitch and rhythm attention to pitch and rhythm for aural development
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use appropriate terminology in explaining/discussing •
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Elements of AND RESPONDING using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Elements of AND RESPONDING above.
2. Explain Elements of AND RESPONDING to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Elements of AND RESPONDING.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Elements of AND RESPONDING with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Elements of AND RESPONDING important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does it make you a) express initial personal as sad, happy feel?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. imitate short melodies with asked to imitate them paying accuracy in pitch and rhythm attention to pitch and rhythm for aural development
2. use appropriate terminology in explaining/discussing •

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
